caseStudies.title: E-Commerce Fashion Brand Scale
caseStudies.summary: Scaled a direct-to-consumer fashion label from breakeven to 5.4x return on ad spend within 60 days.
caseStudies.challenge: The client was burning ad budget on broad targeting with generic image creatives, yielding less than 1.4x ROAS and high customer acquisition cost.
caseStudies.strategy: Restructured the entire Meta Ads funnel into TOFU (Top of Funnel - Interest & Lookalikes), MOFU (Engagement retargeting), and BOFU (Cart Abandoners with dynamic catalog ads & scarcity offers). Designed new high-contrast Canva creatives.
caseStudies.results: Achieved $42,800 in tracked sales with an average 5.4x ROAS, cutting the client's cost-per-purchase by 38%.

caseStudies.title: Healthcare Clinic Lead Gen
caseStudies.summary: Generated 240+ qualified patient inquiries via high-intent Google Search campaigns while slashing acquisition costs.
caseStudies.challenge: Client was bidding on broad, unqualified keywords ('dental care', 'teeth info') which drained their budget without yielding actual booking appointments.
caseStudies.strategy: Audited search query reports, deployed 120+ negative keywords, and rebuilt tightly themed ad groups targeting commercial intent queries ('dental implants near me', 'emergency dentist booking').
caseStudies.results: Delivered 240+ verified appointment requests in 90 days, reducing Cost Per Lead from $25.20 down to $13.80.

caseStudies.title: Facebook Page & Community Overhaul
caseStudies.summary: Revitalized a dormant brand page into an active community with consistent viral engagement and follower growth.
caseStudies.challenge: The brand page had 5,000 inactive followers with near-zero organic reach (less than 20 likes per post) and no clear visual identity.
caseStudies.strategy: Redesigned page visuals, optimized the bio for discovery SEO, introduced interactive carousel posts, and implemented an algorithm-favored reel and polling schedule.
caseStudies.results: Organic reach surged 380% in 45 days, gaining over 14,200 organic followers and generating steady organic direct messages for their products.

caseStudies.title: Ad Creative & Canva Visual Revamp
caseStudies.summary: Re-engineered social ad creatives using high-converting Canva templates to cure ad fatigue and 4x the click-through rate.
caseStudies.challenge: Client's existing ads looked like stock photography, suffering severe ad fatigue within 4 days of launching.
caseStudies.strategy: Designed 12 bespoke Canva ad variants featuring customer UGC frames, clear problem/solution split screens, and bold benefit typography highlighting urgency.
caseStudies.results: Click-through rate quadrupled from 0.8% to 3.2%, lowering the CPC and boosting overall add-to-cart conversions by 65%.

faqs.question: What ad budget do I need to get started with Meta or Google Ads?
faqs.answer: For Meta Ads, I generally recommend starting with a testing budget of at least $15–$30/day to collect sufficient conversion data. For Google Ads, budget depends on your industry keyword CPCs, typically starting from $500–$1,000/month.

faqs.question: How quickly can I expect to see results?
faqs.answer: For Facebook Page Optimization and Canva Creatives, improvements in engagement are visible within the first 7–14 days. For paid campaigns (Meta & Google Ads), initial test results appear in week 1, with stabilized, scalable ROAS typically achieved by weeks 3 to 4.

faqs.question: Do you design the ad graphics and write the copy as well?
faqs.answer: Yes! Full-service execution is one of my strongest advantages. I design high-converting Canva ad creatives, craft psychological ad copy, and handle all technical campaign setups.

faqs.question: How do we communicate and track campaign progress?
faqs.answer: We maintain continuous communication via WhatsApp or Email, accompanied by transparent bi-weekly or monthly visual reports covering spend, ROAS, leads, and actionable next steps.
